Subject: Quick ask: customer refs for procurement + APAC pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team at Stratus Energy is keen to move toward procurement but we need a short set of customer references for the APAC pilot (grid optimization / real-time dispatch use case). Procurement expects: 1) two live customer calls (one from APAC preferred), 2) confirmation on latency profile for near-real-time inference, and 3) a short written example we can include in our internal evaluation memo.

We’re late-stage in the funnel and looking to close within the quarter; our legal and procurement folks will review the references this week. Attached is a redacted RFP excerpt with the sections they care about (latency targets, data handling). Can you help match us to 2–3 customers who can speak to: APAC deployments, deterministic latency under 200ms p95, and integration with SCADA systems?

If possible we’d like one of the calls to be recorded (for internal review) and a short case blurb afterwards. Our lead technical reviewer is Dr. Mei Tan (cc’d) — she’s available Wed/Thu mornings next week (APAC time).

Appreciate any quick suggestions.

Best,
Connor
Director, Strategic Programs
Stratus Energy

Hannah / Lauren,

Thanks for the ping — I pulled together a short slate we can approach. High-level picks (with rationale):

1) GridCore Australia — production APAC deployment, integrated with NSW state SCADA for near-real-time dispatch. Good on telemetry and happy to discuss deterministic latency (they use Redwood Dedicated). Contact: Sarah Nguyen (CTO). Available mid-morning AEST.

2) VoltScale India — pilot completed on distribution-level load forecasting with sub-200ms p95 for inference-serving on edge appliances. More ops-focused, comfortable with recorded calls; prefer short agenda. Contact: Arjun Mehta (Platform Lead).

3) AER Networks (New Zealand) — smaller deployment but heavy on SCADA connectors; can speak to integration hurdles and SSO/KMS setup. Contact: Dr. Mei Tan (they worked with her before) — NOTE: Mei was cc’d on Connor’s email so she may be a Stratus internal, ignore duplication if so.

I’ve checked with CS: GridCore and VoltScale are willing to do a 30–45m recorded technical call and sign a simple NDA if needed. AER Networks prefers not to be recorded but will do live Q&A and provide a written blurb.

Attached is a short reference_brief.docx that we can share with each advocate to help prep. I’ll reach out to Sarah and Arjun once Hannah confirms.

—Marcus
